title: WorkspaceCreate
description: Request body for creating a new workspace.

workspaceGroupID.description: Unique identifier of the workspace group to create the workspace in.

name.description: Human-readable name for the new workspace.

size.description: Size designation for the workspace controlling vCPUs and memory (e.g., S-00, S-1, S-2).

cacheConfig.description: Cache multiplier for the workspace. Valid values are 1, 2, or 4.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp after which the workspace will be automatically terminated.

AutoSuspendConfig.description: Configuration controlling automatic suspension of a workspace after a period of inactivity to reduce compute costs.

suspended.description: When true, auto-suspend is enabled and the workspace will suspend after the specified idle interval.

suspendAfterSeconds.description: Number of seconds of inactivity after which the workspace is automatically suspended.
